2016 men, bhartiy vayu sena ke pathankot bes par huaa ek aatanki hamla. desh par aae is sankat ka samna kiya vayu sena ki garur kamando phors aur bharat ke sarvashreshth suraksha bal, neshnal sikyoriti gard ne. dekhie, is aatankrodhi mishan ki sachchi kahani speshal opreshans : indiya ‘pathankot’ men.
When terrorism threatened the nation's security at Pathankot, India’s Special Forces stood strong to defend our country and its citizens. Watch the true account of their extraordinary fearlessness in .
